patch_info.description: Patch numbers per version and track. Format: { "version": { "track": patchNumber } }

patch_enabled.description: Global flag to enable/disable patch checking

min_required_version.description: Minimum app version required per track. JSON {"stable": "1.0.0", "beta": "1.0.5"}

latest_version.description: Latest available version per track. JSON {"stable": "1.0.29", "beta": "1.0.30"}

redirect_url.description: Redirection URLs for each platform and track. JSON {"android": {"stable": "<url>", ...}, "ios": {"stable": "<url>", ...}}
